0.1.0.lead: The first version of nexdiary: accounts for the family and a safe sign-in.

sections.title: Accounts for the family
sections.body: The operator invites by link; every person makes an account of their own. The operator never sees entries.

sections.title: Second factor
sections.body: Besides the password, a code from an app on your phone, with recovery codes on paper.

small: Light or dark applies to your account, on every device.
